title: How to organize the upper cabinet zone | Kitchen
description:
Light storage at eye level and above for the dishes you reach for every day.

This is the Upper Cabinet Zone in the Kitchen. About 30-45 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
Everything used daily sits between shoulder and eye height, one category per stack, no plate stack more than about six high. Every mug can be lifted without moving another mug. The top shelf holds only what you need less than once a month, and the platter for eight lives up there.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Count the mugs, then count the people who drink from them.
Straighten: Put dinner plates and everyday bowls at eye level on the side nearest the dishwasher or the table, glasses bes
Shine: Take each shelf completely empty before wiping, because the band of dust at the back is how you find out it ha
Safety: Heavy and breakable do not belong above head height.
Standardize: Label the shelf edge rather than the contents: plates, bowls, glasses, mugs.
Sustain: Emptying the dishwasher is the check.

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
Daily dishes between shoulder and eye height, one category per stack, top shelf reserved for what you use less than monthly.

Full written steps for this zone, free:
https://6s-success.com/zones/kitchen-the-upper-cabinets.html

6S Success turns Lean's six-S method into something you can actually do in a house: Sort, Straighten, Shine, Safety, Standardize, Sustain. One small zone at a time, finished in one session, and it stays finished.
